identity.note: Map-local child IDs and coordinates may repeat in another map. Persisted, catalog, external, and cross-map references compose mapId with the applicable child ID; one match instead carries the immutable selected mapId and revision.

connectionPolicy.physicalConnections: Every pair of inventoried cells separated by one named axial direction.
connectionPolicy.playableConnections: Physical connections whose two endpoints are playable; terrain endpoints are excluded.

source.coordinateDiagramStatus: Independently source-reviewed playable cells and printed spawn glyphs; private source and prepared artwork remain excluded.
